about_the_game:
Support the development of Buck Trucker's future adventures! 

Fire up your big rig's speakers with the official soundtrack to Buck Trucker in Rowdy Business!

This original soundtrack is the perfect companion for whether you're helping Buck Trucker adventure through the Golden Palm Casino or hittin' that dusty trail in your very own big rig. Here are 7 hit tracks from disco to ol' country blues to help you keep on truckin'.

Originally packed with the 1st edition game box courtesy of Slimecore Records

content_descriptors.notes: Mild language and descriptions of sexual activity.
